description: North Western Province - Notifying that the Provincial Council of North Western Province has approved the By-laws relating to solid Waste Management of Municipal Councils, Urban Councils and Pradeshiya Sabhas Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1933/40 of 25.09.2015
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the approval of "Solid Waste Management" by-laws for Municipal Councils, Urban Councils, and Pradeshiya Sabhas by the North Western Province Provincial Council. The notification references specific statutes (Local Authorities Statute No. 6 of 1952 and Provincial Council Statute No. 12 of 1989) and involves the creation of regulatory frameworks for waste management. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory matters and subsidiary legislation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
